comments.author: Apoorv .
comments.comment: The hard part with agents usually starts after the demo works: eval sets, rollback paths, latency budgets, and deciding what the agent is not allowed to do. Curious which part of the program changed how you think about taking an agent from prototype to production?

comments.author: Medhavi Basera
comments.comment: A useful next eval is “answerable vs unanswerable” before grading. In note-only RAG, the model needs to say “not enough evidence in my notes” as reliably as it answers from retrieved chunks, otherwise hallucination rate looks better than the actual study experience.
